subject: Pricing alignment and packaging options for Neptune Commerce
messages:
From: Peter Cole <peter.cole@neptunecommerce.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.example
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.example, procurement@neptunecommerce.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing alignment and packaging options for Neptune Commerce

Hi Jonas + Lauren,

Thanks for the demo last week — product looked great. We're in the home stretch evaluating a replacement for HelioCloud and I wanted to put a few concrete asks on the table so we can compare apples-to-apples: 

- Can Redwood match HelioCloud's list pricing on the inference runtime (they're quoting $0.016/1k tokens for generate, $0.004/compute-embed unit) if we commit to a 12-month term?
- We're sensitive to egress costs and want a clear credit/waiver approach if we can offload logs to our lakehouse during the first 90 days.
- Packaging: do you have a fixed "platform + support" SKU (single invoice) versus separate seat-based + runtime pricing? Our procurement team prefers simpler billing.

If you can send a short, numbered proposal and any attachments we can circulate internally, that would help. We're targeting a decision by Oct 23.

Best,
Peter
Peter Cole
Head of Platform Engineering — Neptune Commerce
---
Neptune Commerce | peter.cole@neptunecommerce.com
From: jonas_weber@redwood.example
To: Peter Cole <peter.cole@neptunecommerce.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.example
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing alignment and packaging options for Neptune Commerce

Peter — appreciate the clear asks. High level response below; attaching a working pricing sheet so we can iterate.

1) List pricing: we can propose a 12-month fixed offer that matches the effective runtime rate you quoted for a specific committed tier (see sheet). 
2) Egress: we can provide a 90-day egress credit (up to a defined cap) for integration/archival exports — will need volume numbers to size it.
3) Packaging: we have two common approaches: 
   - "Unified" SKU: platform + 24/7 support + reserved capacity pool (single PO) 
   - "Modular": seat/license + runtime tokens + optional support add-on (itemized)

I've attached: neptune_custom_pricing_sheet_v1.xlsx (baseline tiers + suggested concession). Can you share last 3 months of token consumption and a rough egress estimate? I'll pull Lauren in with a draft that mirrors HelioCloud's economics.

Next steps: if you like, 30-min call Thurs to walk the numbers?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.example | +1-415-555-0182
Attachment: neptune_custom_pricing_sheet_v1.xlsx (Excel, 78KB)

Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing alignment and packaging options for Neptune Commerce

Peter — looping in Connor from Solutions to call out onboarding and egress mechanics. Quick read: 

- We can commit to a 12-month fixed rate that holds runtime at the effective HelioCloud numbers for the first 12 months if Neptune agrees to a minimum monthly committed usage (we recommend a 20% headroom buffer to avoid throttles). See pricing sheet tab "Fixed-12m Proposal".
- On egress credits: proposal = 90-day egress credit up to $25k, then reduced rate thereafter; for larger migration windows we can structure a staged credit.
- Packaging option we recommend for you: Unified SKU with a single PO (reduces procurement friction). Includes onboarding hours (40 hrs) + one migration support engineer during cutover. Extra onboarding is T&M.

Connor — can you confirm the onboarding SOW estimate and if we should offer an accelerated 60-day migration SLA for an additional one-time fee?

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Commercial Lead | Redwood Inference

Peter — quick note on onboarding numbers: 

- Baseline onboarding included in Unified SKU: 40 hours of integration support (engineer and CS), weekly playbook check-ins for first 30 days. 
- If you want an accelerated 60-day migration SLA we'll commit an additional senior engineer for 2 weeks (estimate: $18k one-time).
- For the egress credit: to implement automatic credits we need a migration runbook and an S3 egress audit window; technically feasible and low risk.

Happy to jump on a technical sync if you'd like to review cutover steps.

Connor O'Brien
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pricing alignment and packaging options for Neptune Commerce

Team — this is helpful. Two follow-ups before we lock it in: 

1) Inflation-adjusted clause: can Redwood guarantee the fixed runtime rate for 12 months but allow a one-time CPI-linked adjustment (cap 3%) after month 12 if needed? We prefer some protection for long-term runs.
2) Egress: $25k cap is fine for our initial rollout, but procurement asks for an explicit egress waiver for the first 15TB of migration data (we can provide manifests). Could that be treated outside the cap?

If you can map those two items into the pricing sheet and a short term sheet we can take to procurement this afternoon. We'll aim to send PO the week of Oct 26 if terms align.

Thanks,
Peter

Peter — great, we can do both asks. Summary of final commercial points (will drop into the pricing sheet + term sheet):

A) Pricing: 12-month fixed runtime rates matching HelioCloud equivalent for committed tier (detailed in attached sheet). After month 12, a one-time CPI-linked adjustment up to a 3% cap is permitted.

B) Egress: First 15TB of migration egress waived (no hit to $25k credit cap). Additional egress during first 90 days falls under the previously described credit policy.

C) Packaging: Unified SKU recommended — single invoice that includes: platform access, reserved capacity pool, 24/7 support, onboarding (40 hrs). Accelerated 60-day migration SLA available for $18k one-time.

Attachments: neptune_custom_pricing_sheet_v1.xlsx, neptune_onboard_estimate.pdf.  
Links: HubSpot record https://hubspot.example/contacts/NEP-47, DocuSign term template https://docusign.example/template/ND-2026-NEP-47
